description:
In MySQL Workbench, create a new database connection to connect to the local MySQL server. Use these connection details:

- Connection Name: SakilaDB
- Hostname: localhost (or 127.0.0.1)
- Port: 3306
- Username: ga
- Password: password123

After entering the connection details, click the 'Test Connection' button to verify it works. You should see a success message confirming the connection parameters are correct. Then click OK to save the connection. The connection should appear in the MySQL Workbench home screen under 'MySQL Connections'.
